name: Package Management
description: Install or uninstall an APK by URL, update the panel's System WebView, and neutralize intrusive vendor packages. Requires root; no vendor signature pinning or auto-update machinery — you choose what to install.
author: David Coulson

settings.title: APK to install (URL)
settings.description: HTTPS URL to an APK. Trigger the Install action below to download and install it.

settings.title: Uninstall: pick a known package
settings.description: Common vendor/test packages, so you don't have to type one. Run the Uninstall package action to apply. Anything typed into the field below takes priority over this pick. Uninstalling is not reversible without a factory reset or reflash — prefer taming if you only want an app to stop interfering.

settings.title: Package to uninstall
settings.description: Overrides the dropdown above when non-empty. Use for anything not listed there.

settings.title: System WebView: known-good build
settings.description: Builds ha-paneld verified on real panels and mirrors as durable release assets, for panels with no Google Play and therefore no WebView update path. Pick the one matching this panel's ABI and Android version — a mismatch fails the install rather than damaging anything, but WebView renders the dashboard, so confirm the panel still loads afterwards. These are LineageOS/Cromite SystemWebView builds, not Google-signed; a panel that still gets WebView through Play should use Play instead.

settings.title: System WebView APK (URL)
settings.description: HTTPS URL to a com.android.webview build for this panel's ABI. Overrides the dropdown above when non-empty. Trigger the Update WebView action below.

settings.title: elclcd OTA updater
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 panels. The one entry ha-paneld documents plainly as a safe, reversible disable — left running it can re-enable ADB and push vendor firmware under you. Package: com.elclcd.otaupdater

settings.title: elclcd keepalive service
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 panels. The vendor's process-resurrector — this is what undoes taming anything else, so tame it alongside whatever else you tame on these panels. Package: com.elclcd.commonkeepalive

settings.title: Factory test: DeviceTest
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 and px30 panels. A factory/QA leftover with no runtime role on a deployed panel. Package: com.DeviceTest

settings.title: Factory test: elc smt_test
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 and px30 panels. Factory/QA leftover. Package: com.elc.smt_test

settings.title: Factory test: cghs stresstest
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 and px30 panels. Factory/QA leftover. Package: com.cghs.stresstest

settings.title: Factory test: smatek test
settings.description: Verified on rk3576 and px30 panels. Factory/QA leftover. Package: com.smatek.test

settings.title: SmartOS/xinch settings app
settings.description: Documented in ha-paneld's hardware notes, not verified on a panel here. If it isn't installed on your model, toggling this does nothing. Package: com.smartos.xinch.setting

settings.title: SmartOS/xinch hardware service
settings.description: Documented in ha-paneld's hardware notes, not verified on a panel here. Note the ethernet platform service is deliberately not offered — disabling it on a wired panel would strand it. Package: com.smartos.xinch.hardware

settings.title: Tuya device test app
settings.description: Documented in ha-paneld's hardware notes, not verified on a panel here. Package: com.tuya.devicetest

settings.title: Tamed vendor packages
settings.description: Extra packages to tame, space or comma separated, for anything not listed above. Added to the toggles, not instead of them. Critical system packages are always refused.

settings.title: Simulation mode
settings.description: Test the controls without touching hardware or packages.
